title: REQ · GameLayout really uses Button, Lucide and Motion
summary: Drawer toggle uses Button with a Lucide icon and aside uses Motion
description: Context: GameLayout renders a plain button and aside. Desired behavior: the Story toggle is the shadcn Button with a Lucide ChevronUp icon (aria-hidden), and the aside is a motion.aside, with unchanged class names, aria-expanded and accessible name 'Story'. Expected result: lucide-react and motion are imported by shipped code.
acceptance_criteria: Given GameLayout, when rendered, then a button named 'Story' with aria-expanded 'false' exists and contains an svg icon
Given the toggle clicked, when state flips, then aside has class drawer-open and aria-expanded is 'true'
Given package.json, when read, then lucide-react and motion are dependencies
Given the existing layout tests, when run, then they still pass

preserve: Class names game-layout, scene-area, story-panel, drawer-open

definition_of_done: Layout uses stack and tests pass
